claims: Morocco has been declared the official winner of the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON)
A March 2026 Confederation of African Football (CAF) ruling overturned Senegal’s initial 1-0 victory
Senegal was stripped of the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) title
The 2025 AFCON final occurred on January 18, 2026
Senegal initially beat hosts Morocco 1-0 in the 2025 AFCON final
Senegal was found to have breached regulations in the 2025 AFCON final
The breach resulted in a 3-0 technical loss for Senegal
CAF Appeal Board upheld an appeal from the Royal Moroccan Football Federation (FRMF)
The appeal followed protests during the 2025 AFCON final
The decision was finalized 57 days after the final
